name: Keyboard Remapper
author: houz42
description: Evdev-level tap/hold key remaps via keyd. Add/remove rules right from the popup (written to gitignored user-rules.json) or edit rules.json directly. Ships with one example: tap the physical Alt key alone to emit F12 (for herdr's prefix), while holding Alt still works as a normal modifier.

barWidget.description: Toggle keyd tap/hold remap rules from the bar.
